canon.note: Basic Novaburst (120801) Quantum DMG = 50% of ATK at Lv6 / 70% at L10, scaling off Max HP. Skill Network of Preserving Strings (120802): team matrix; #4 L10 = Fu Xuan Max HP +6%, #5 = CRIT Rate +12% for the team, matrix lasts 3 turns. Ultimate Woes of Many Morphed to One (120803) Quantum DMG #1 L10 = 100% of Max HP to all enemies. Bonus A4: Fu Xuan Max HP +6% (Knowledge of Preserving). Energy limit 120.

fixtures.env: Fu Xuan E0 solo vs 3 Quantum-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7 — Max HP scaling kit

requirements.claim: Talent Misfortune Avoidance: while Fu Xuan is alive the whole team takes less DMG — permanent mitigation buff fx_ma (preservation.ts:201-207).
Basic ATK Novaburst (120801, Quantum) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Network of Preserving Strings (120802) is Fu Xuan's Skill; the fixture casts it 2 times.
Woes of Many Morphed to One (120803) is Fu Xuan's Ultimate action; cast twice.
Fu Xuan's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; never a generic attack action.
Novaburst (120801) deals Quantum DMG equal to 50% of Max HP at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (canon L10 = 70%); the engine reads the stat as Max HP.
Woes of Many Morphed to One (120803) #1 = 100% of Max HP at L10.

of.label: Woes of Many Morphed to One

requirements.claim: Knowledge of Preserving #4: Fu Xuan's Max HP increases by 6% at L10 (120802); HP-scaling hits resolve against 11800 x 1.06 = 12508.
The Skill applies Knowledge of Preserving to Fu Xuan, lasting 3 turns.
Knowledge of Preserving #5: CRIT Rate +12% at L10 for the team.
The Skill establishes the Matrix of Preserving on the team (3 turns).
Each Skill costs 1 Skill Point; 2 Skill casts spend 2 SP.
Each Basic ATK restores 1 Skill Point; 3 Basics gain 3 SP.
Woes of Many Morphed to One uses the standard Energy ladder (120); this rotation regenerates exactly 208 Energy.
The Matrix buff is applied by the first Skill cast before the next action's Novaburst damage resolves.
Knowledge of Preserving lands during the Skill, before the first Novaburst damage resolves.
